data.name: keep-notes
data.description: Keep works on your phone, tablet and computer. Everything you add to Keep syncs across web so your important stuff is always with you.

data.name: booksScrapy
data.description: This project is a Scrapy-based web scraper that extracts book data from Books to Scrape, validates the data, and stores it in a PostgreSQL database. The scraper captures various details about each book, including title, price, availability, rating, description, and more.

data.name: celery-as-service
data.description: This repository contains the necessary files and instructions to configure Celery as a systemd service for your application. Follow the steps provided to set up and manage Celery efficiently, ensuring it runs as a service on your system.

data.name: Boilerplate-Next-Js
data.description: This repository provides a feature-rich boilerplate for Next.js, integrating MUI v5, TypeScript, Storybook, Zeplin, ESLint, Prettier, Husky, Lint-Staged, Jest, Testing Library, Commitlint, VSCode, Vercel, and PostCSS. It is designed to enhance developer experience, streamline development processes.

data.name: task_management_system
data.description: A streamlined task management system for organizations to create, assign, and monitor tasks. Features include task creation, user/team assignment, status tracking, priority settings, and due date management. The intuitive dashboard provides real-time insights, enhancing productivity and fostering collaboration across teams.
